description: Na₄P₄N₄H₁₀O₁₁ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three PN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 75°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three PN₂O₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five PN₂O₂ tetrahedra and edges with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.63 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five PN₂O₂ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.48 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) P-N bond length. Both P-O bond lengths are 1.52 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and corners with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. There is one shorter (1.68 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) P-N bond length. There is one shorter (1.51 Å) and one longer (1.52 Å) P-O bond length. In the third P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. Both P-N bond lengths are 1.69 Å. Both P-O bond lengths are 1.52 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two PN₂O₂ tetrahedra and corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) P-N bond length. There is one shorter (1.51 Å) and one longer (1.52 Å) P-O bond length. There are four inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.02 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two P and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.02 Å. There are ten inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) H-O bond length. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the seventh H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the eighth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. In the ninth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the tenth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom.
